title: RTK Query Interview Preparation
summary: Prepare for specific RTK Query interview questions with typed examples, production incidents, modern 2.12 APIs, 42 scenario questions, and a mock interview.
audience: React and TypeScript engineers preparing for mid-level and senior interviews about RTK Query and production server-state correctness.

units.title: Foundations and Request Ownership
units.summary: Explain the typed API, server-state ownership, hook flags, and cache identity.

units.title: Cache Identity and Invalidation
units.summary: Design scoped tags and distinguish retention, freshness, and list membership.

units.title: Mutations and Error Recovery
units.summary: Reason about optimistic races, handled errors, reauthorization, and retries.

units.title: Persistence and the Loading Incident
units.summary: Investigate orphaned pending state and design a safe tested restart policy.

units.title: Modern APIs and Version Traps
units.summary: Use infinite queries and runtime schemas with precise RTK version boundaries.

units.title: Production Architecture and Testing
units.summary: Plan API boundaries, streaming, native listeners, server ownership, and tests.

units.title: Mock Interview and Code Review
units.summary: Practice specific questions, flawed-code review, production scenarios, and a rubric.
